title: pseuderanthemum malaccense
intro: Pseuderanthemum malaccense, commonly known as the Malay mint, is a species of flowering plant in the family Acanthaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues. The health benefits of P. malaccense include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which have been reported to aid in wound healing and reduce fever. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as analgesia, anti-diarrheal, and antioxidant activities.
